scope: Local C11 processor-systems workstation, bounded diagnostics and metrics, Win32 GUI and portable CLI.

reference.warning: The supplied 66-point list mixes cumulative updates, inherited behavior, absence statements, repeated topics and Windows-specific constraints. It is not treated as an authoritative XP SP3 changelog or as a requirement to reproduce legacy Windows behavior.

adoption_rules.rule: Only claim implemented when repository code and tests or operational evidence support the exact behavior. Partial requires evidence and explicit limits. Not applicable requires a product-scope reason. Historical Windows features are not silently represented as native capabilities.

source_groups.title: User interface, shell, multimedia and storage

controls.assessment: The tool performs bounded, read-only local inspection and advisory analysis; it does not control OS scheduling, firmware or device state.
limitations: Keep host inspection read-only and validate external inputs before analysis.

controls.assessment: Pytyliki is a local workstation with no hosted service or network control plane in its current scope.
limitations: Do not introduce network dependencies for an offline processor tool.

controls.assessment: CMake builds and test targets are provided for supported platforms; no signed system installer or automatic OS servicing mechanism is claimed.
limitations: Keep build and packaging outputs separate from host configuration changes.

controls.assessment: A Windows GUI and portable command-line interface exist; the product is not a general desktop shell or system file manager.
limitations: UI improvements must preserve portable core behavior and accessibility.

controls.assessment: The C11 core and versioned C ABI provide defined portability boundaries; live probes and GUI behavior remain platform-dependent.
limitations: Document per-platform probe availability rather than inferring capability from compilation.
